claim_summary: Sharp strong-reset rare-event asymptotic for the weak-coupling angular-velocity susceptibility of a two-temperature Brownian gyrator with independent Poisson resets to a uniform circle; exact sign and contrast with algebraic angular-momentum susceptibility.
integrity: Analytic proof and deterministic numerical reproduction are provided; numerical checks alone are not certification of asymptotics; originality comparison is same-model and may have missed non-indexed literature.
limitations: Fixed distinct positive bath temperatures and strictly positive circle radius
Not uniform at coincident temperatures or zero radius
Related exact stationary integral formulas and renewal methods are prior; unindexed equivalent asymptotics remain possible
title: Beyond-all-orders angular-velocity susceptibility under circular resetting
